verses.ar: «أَتَحْسِبُ هَذَا حَقًّا؟ قُلْتَ: أَنَا أَبَرُّ مِنَ ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Thinkest thou this to be right, [that] thou saidst, My righteousness [is] more than God’s?
verses.web: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ قُلْتَ: مَاذَا يُفِيدُكَ؟ بِمَاذَا أَنْتَفِعُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ خَطِيَّتِي؟
verses.kjv: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? [and], What profit shall I have, [if I be cleansed] from my sin?
verses.web: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

verses.ar: أَنَا أَرُدُّ عَلَيْكَ كَلَامًا، وَعَلَى أَصْحَابِكَ مَعَكَ.
verses.kjv: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.
verses.web: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

verses.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَأَبْصِرْ، وَلَاحِظِ ٱلْغَمَامَ. إِنَّهَا أَعْلَى مِنْكَ.
verses.kjv: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds [which] are higher than thou.
verses.web: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

verses.ar: إِنْ أَخْطَأْتَ فَمَاذَا فَعَلْتَ بِهِ؟ وَإِنْ كَثَّرْتَ مَعَاصِيَكَ فَمَاذَا عَمِلْتَ لَهُ؟
verses.kjv: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or [if] thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?
verses.web: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتَ بَارًّا فَمَاذَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ؟ أَوْ مَاذَا يَأْخُذُهُ مِنْ يَدِكَ؟
verses.kjv: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?
verses.web: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

verses.ar: لِرَجُلٍ مِثْلِكَ شَرُّكَ، وَلِٱبْنِ آدَمَ بِرُّكَ.
verses.kjv: Thy wickedness [may hurt] a man as thou [art;] and thy righteousness [may profit] the son of man.
verses.web: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

verses.ar: «مِنْ كَثْرَةِ ٱلْمَظَالِمِ يَصْرُخُونَ. يَسْتَغِيثُونَ مِنْ ذِرَاعِ ٱلْأَعِزَّاءِ.
verses.kjv: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make [the oppressed] to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.web: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

verses.ar: وَلَمْ يَقُولُوا: أَيْنَ ٱللهُ صَانِعِي، مُؤْتِي ٱلْأَغَانِيِّ فِي ٱللَّيْلِ،
verses.kjv: But none saith, Where [is] God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;
verses.web: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي يُعَلِّمُنَا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ وُحُوشِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَيَجْعَلُنَا أَحْكَمَ مِنْ طُيُورِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ؟
verses.kjv: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
verses.web: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

verses.ar: ثَمَّ يَصْرُخُونَ مِنْ كِبْرِيَاءِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ وَلَا يَسْتَجِيبُ.
verses.kjv: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.web: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنَّ ٱللهَ لَا يَسْمَعُ كَذِبًا، وَٱلْقَدِيرُ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.web: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا قُلْتَ إِنَّكَ لَسْتَ تَرَاهُ، فَٱلدَّعْوَى قُدَّامَهُ، فَٱصْبِرْ لَهُ.
verses.kjv: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, [yet] judgment [is] before him; therefore trust thou in him.
verses.web: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَلِأَنَّ غَضَبَهُ لَا يُطَالِبُ، وَلَا يُبَالِي بِكَثْرَةِ ٱلزَّلَّاتِ،
verses.kjv: But now, because [it is] not [so], he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth [it] not in great extremity:
verses.web: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

verses.ar: فَغَرَ أَيُّوبُ فَاهُ بِٱلْبَاطِلِ، وَكَبَّرَ ٱلْكَلَامَ بِلَا مَعْرِفَةٍ».
verses.kjv: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.
verses.web: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
